body:
# 👁️ Custom Entity – The Stalker

A horror-based AI plugin that adds a stalking entity with intelligent behavior, jumpscares, and dynamic difficulty.

---

## 🧠 AI System
- IDLE, STALKING, WATCHING, CHASING states
- Weeping Angel-style mechanic (freezes when looked at)
- Smart pathfinding and targeting

---

## ⚔️ Features
- Melee combat with knockback
- Lightning strike effects
- Jumpscare system
- Camera shake support

---

## 🌙 Spawning
- Spawns at night (or always on high difficulty)
- Per-player cooldown
- Spawns outside player vision

---

## 🛡️ Player Control
- Hunt whitelist (who can be targeted)
- Safe whitelist (protected players)

---

## 🎮 Commands
- /ce spawn  
- /ce reload  
- /ce removeall  
- /ce whitelist add/remove/list  

---

## 🎨 Custom Skins

Custom skins **require Citizens**.

### 1. Install Citizens

Download the latest build from:

https://ci.citizensnpcs.co/job/citizens2/

### 2. Install Citizens

Drop the Citizens plugin into your server's `plugins` folder and restart the server.

### 3. Add Your Skin

Place your custom PNG skin inside:

```text
plugins/CustomEntity/skins/
```

Rename the skin to:

```text
stalker.png
```

The plugin will automatically apply this skin to The Stalker.

> **Note:** If Citizens is not installed, custom skins will **not** work. The plugin will fall back to the default appearance.


---

## 🤝 Compatibility
- Paper / Spigot / Bukkit
- Minecraft 1.21.1+
- Soft dependency: Citizens (optional)
